Luceat.caption: Without Luceat the room stays dark. With it the lamp lights the room.

Light strength.caption: Light strength changes how bright every light is.

Brightness limit.caption: The limit stops stacked lights from turning white.

Fade in daylight.caption: In daylight the lamp fades out so it does not look odd.

Surface direction.caption: Surfaces facing the light are brighter than surfaces facing away.

Light bounce.caption: Light bounces off surfaces and softly fills places the light cannot reach directly.

Replace normal light.caption: Placed lights replace the flat vanilla light with real light.

Light around corners.caption: Light spreads around corners and into places it cannot reach in a straight line.

Corner light strength.caption: A higher value pushes more light around the corner.

Corner light steps.caption: Corner light fills the room faster at a higher value.

Rest corner light.caption: Corner light stops updating while nothing moves.

Shiny surfaces.caption: Metal, ice, glass and polished blocks catch a bright highlight.

Sun shadows.caption: In daylight the sun casts shadows from trees and buildings.

Sun shadow strength.caption: A higher value makes sun shadows darker.

Water light patterns.caption: Light shining through water makes moving patterns on the floor.

Shadows.caption: Blocks stop light and leave a shadow behind them.

Shadow darkness.caption: A higher value makes shadows from lights darker.

Soft edges.caption: Soft edges blur the shadow so it looks more natural.

Shadow distance.caption: Shadows only appear close to you. Far away lights stay simple.

Shadow map updates.caption: A higher value rebuilds the shadow map faster after you build.

Lights with shadows.caption: Only the strongest nearby lights cast shadows. More costs more.

Fences, panes, slabs and more.caption: Fences, bars, doors, stairs and slabs cast their real shape.

Grass and flowers.caption: Grass and flowers cast small shadows.

Leaves and holes.caption: Leaves let some light through the holes.

Hole strength.caption: Lower values let more light through leaves.

Coloured glass.caption: Coloured glass tints the light that passes through.

Placed lights.caption: Glowing blocks light their surroundings in their own colour.

Placed light strength.caption: A higher value makes glowing blocks brighter.

Placed light reach.caption: Placed lights reach further with a higher setting.

Blocks from other mods.caption: Glowing blocks from other mods get a Luceat light.

Smallest light.caption: Lights below the smallest level are skipped.

Skip buried lights.caption: Light blocks with no open side are ignored.

Hide lights behind blocks.caption: Lava under the ground does not glow through it.

Join crowded lights.caption: Lava lakes and walls of torches join into a few strong lights.

Crowd size.caption: How many lights a chunk holds before they join.

Join faraway lights.caption: Far away lights close together join into one bigger light.

Join lights past.caption: How far away lights start joining.

Most lights at once.caption: Only the closest lights are used. More lights costs more.

Light range.caption: Lights further away than the range are skipped.

Fire flicker.caption: Warm lights like torches and campfires flicker.

Light on particles.caption: Smoke and sparks get lit by nearby lights.

Water puts out lights.caption: A torch under water goes out.
